adversarialFindings.description: Initial Guild administrator-transfer update targeted a GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY member-order column and failed in disposable PostgreSQL.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Changed member_order to GENERATED BY DEFAULT in the additive migration before reordering; reran the disposable Guild Commons SQL probe to PASS, exercising old social_week administrator logic.

adversarialFindings.description: Guild posts and profile risk cross-Guild read/write, stale account misuse, and administrator/author privilege confusion.
adversarialFindings.resolution: RPC uses authenticated Hasura session claims and existing serialized membership advisory lock; strict membership UUID checks and actor-derived group, SQL role checks, response validation, and session-pinned transport; focused SQL tests passed but live Hasura/JWT validation remains an activation gate.

adversarialFindings.description: Seven-day visual expiry could be mistaken for physical erasure of stored Guild messages.
adversarialFindings.resolution: UI describes limited visibility, not guaranteed deletion; SQL removes expired rows on the next authenticated Commons request and cascades on member/Guild deletion. Dormant-Guild physical deletion remains a separately planned retention housekeeping decision.

adversarialFindings.description: Production Nhost installed function, metadata role grants, Auth trigger and account-lifecycle semantics were not read or modified; unverified migration must not be activated.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Feature remains disabled by default. Live Hasura/JWT validation and authorized additive migration required before any enablement; no production readiness claimed.

adversarialFindings.description: A GitHub-source review plus passing disposable SQL and Prettier checks do not constitute the complete repository release gate.
adversarialFindings.resolution: PR must obtain an authentic hosted Final candidate PASS for the exact candidate before any merge. No build/lint/typecheck/Vitest/Playwright pass is invented. Owner's rule: pause this branch after two consecutive FC failures, with no third rerun.

adversarialFindings.description: First hosted Final candidate failed at Prettier format:check on infra/nhost/social/README.md before remaining tests ran.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Compared repository README to Prettier 3.8.4 output in isolated sandbox, removed the one extra blank line, and rebound this review to the new exact payload tree. No other product changes or full-suite pass claimed.
